description: Sir Aldric, a stern grey-eyed armoured knight with short cropped brown hair and a trimmed beard, polished steel plate armour over a blue wool surcoat with a white lion emblem, a leather sword belt, steel gauntlets and heavy riveted leather boots.

removed_gear_full: the plate armour, surcoat, sword belt, gauntlets and boots
